limitations.detail: SIGNED endpoints: HMAC SHA256 over totalParams (query string concatenated with request body), signature appended at end; requires timestamp (ms) param, optional recvWindow (default 5000); API key in X-MBX-APIKEY header
V3 API (recommended) uses Web3 wallet/agent signing (user/signer/nonce/signature) not expressible here; V1 new API-key creation stopped after 2026-03-25, existing keys still work
Authenticated V3 endpoints require a main-wallet deposit after 2026-09-01 (error -5050); public market data unaffected
Kline response example not shown in provided docs; Binance-compatible columnar array assumed with ts=0,open=1,high=2,low=3,close=4,volume=5 â verify on first call
exchangeInfo / ticker/24hr / depth field names and nesting not documented in provided corpus; field_map omitted

Futures only: LIMIT, MARKET, STOP, STOP_MARKET, TAKE_PROFIT, TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET; GTC/IOC/FOK/GTX; hedge & one-way position modes; no spot endpoints documented at fapi base (spot on sapi.asterdex.com per third-party only)

Perpetual futures (contractType PERPETUAL), leverage 1-125 via POST /fapi/v1/leverage, marginType ISOLATED/CROSSED, funding-rate model; funding interval and rate not stated (see /fapi/v1/premiumIndex, /fapi/v1/fundingRate)
fee_pct not documented (per-user via GET /fapi/v1/commissionRate) â using conservative default 0.2
qty_step not stated globally; per-symbol stepSize via exchangeInfo LOT_SIZE filter â using default 8
price band per-symbol via PERCENT_PRICE filter (markPrice * multiplierUp/Down), exact pct not stated â using default 5.0
min/max collateral per position not documented â using defaults 10.0/100000.0
interest_per_4h_pct: funding fees per symbol, no fixed value documented â using default 0.05
min_order_usdt=5.0 taken from MIN_NOTIONAL error -4164 ('notional must be no smaller than 5.0 unless reduce only'); per-symbol MIN_NOTIONAL filter may differ

Rate limits are weight-based (REQUEST_WEIGHT/ORDERS per exchangeInfo rateLimits), enforced per IP; docs give no fixed req/sec â 0.05s gap assumed from 1200 weight/min cited in third-party guide; 429 then auto IP ban (HTTP 418, 2min-3days)
HTTP 503 timeout responses have UNKNOWN execution status and must not be treated as failure; indexPriceKlines/markPriceKlines use 'pair'/'symbol' params respectively
